thread:
emily: SkyWarp said they can join the EAP but asked for a single mutual NDA + short embargo. They can ship two units and want our bench harness. Who can own the bench + perf keys? @nate?
nate: I can take the harness. Need to confirm test matrix: models (fast-3b/7b), seq len (2k vs 4k), and quant profiles (fp16, int8). Also prefer to run a 1h soak to capture thermal throttling.
claire: Legal will review the NDA redline. Mutual 10-business-day embargo is likely OK but we'll insist on aggregated metrics only and no prompt-level logs.
ops-bot: LAB: accept Tue/Thu only. MAX_WEIGHT=25kg. COURIER=PREFERRED:DHL. Please attach COA form.
matt-skywarp: We can ship Mon with drivers preloaded. We'll provide a container image after NDA is signed. Our internal stress config is `--threads=48 --seq=4096` which tends to hit thermal ceilings after ~30m. We'll include driver/kernel versions in the manifest.
sarah-marketing: Marketing needs a partner blurb, logos (svg), and a 1-paragraph use case. Also confirm embargo window to align PR calendar.
nate: Bench plan (short): 2 cold runs (cache off) per model/quant, 1 warm run for p95/p50, 1x 60m soak with telemetry. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s sustained, avg_power (W), max_gpu_temp. Example run command to be committed to bench repo:
```
./run_eap.sh \
  --model redwood/fast-7b \
  --seq 4096 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant int8 \
  --threads 48 \
  --collect gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq,mem_bw \
  --soak 3600 \
  --synthetic-prompts true
```
claire: Please ensure the harness scrubs tokens and that only aggregated perf counters are stored. We'll add a short data-handling addendum to the NDA.
emily: Marketplace: we need SKU, supported regions, and a small architecture diagram for the listing. Also decide if we publish raw numbers or a normalized badge. PM prefers raw numbers only.
matt-skywarp: Uploading NDA redline now: https://files.skywarp.io/nda_redline_eap.pdf. We'll upload logo and image after NDA. We agree to synthetic prompts and aggregated results.
sarah-marketing: If embargo is agreed for mid-Nov, marketing will need assets two weeks prior. Also request a short quote from partner exec.
emily: Action items:
- nate: bench harness + parsers + soak dashboard (due Fri 1755630000)
- claire: review NDA + add data handling addendum (due Wed 1755580000)
- ops-bot / ops: confirm lab slot + COA form (due Tue 1755560000)
- matt-skywarp: upload signed NDA, image, logos, and driver manifest (ETA Mon)
- sarah-marketing: draft PR timeline and partner quote template (due Thu 1755600000)
I'll schedule a 30m kickoff and include the checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
